provenance: Harvested from CapCut 9.4.0 (build 285) on 2026-09-18. Three volume keyframes were authored BY HAND in the CapCut UI on a disposable project's audio clip at 0 dB / -12 dB / 0 dB; capcutctl oracle diff read the record back out of the saved draft. Nothing here was invented or retyped from a screenshot.

units.note: NOT decibels. value = 10 ** (dB / 20). Measured: 0 dB -> 1, -12 dB -> 0.25118863582611084 (float32 of 10**-0.6).

timeBase.note: Same base as the camera keyframe channels, so sourceTime() in opScaleKeyframe applies unchanged. Verified against the authoring UI at 30 fps: timecodes 00:00:00:00 / 00:01:20:24 / 00:02:39:26 stored as 0 / 80800000 / 159866666.

doNotWrite.Timelines/<id>/attachment/patch/mini_dra: CapCut materialises its own copy here with a DIFFERENT encoding — curveType as the integer 0 and a `graph: null` field instead of `graphID: ""`. App cache. Never write it.

sideEffects.materials.sound_channel_mappings[].type: CapCut rewrote '' -> 'none' on the mapped audio material when the clip gained keyframes. Preserve whatever is there; do not normalise it either way.
